objectives: Students will understand unique characteristics and challenges of biologics including monoclonal antibodies, vaccines, oligonucleotides, cell and gene therapy products.
Students will be able to describe regulatory framework and submission requirements.
Students will develop strategies for successful clinical trial applications and marketing approvals.
Students will be able to explain post-market compliance, Pharmacovigilance and risk management requirements.
Students will be knowledgeable in emerging trends such as advanced therapies including cell and gene therapies and vaccine.
Students will be able to strategize, prepare and respond to regulatory authority questions (applications, submissions and inspections).
topics: Introduction to biologics Regulatory framework Clinical trial design and special considerations Chemistry, manufacturing
